name: overlay-element-rect-dialog
description: The page opens the dialog modal of the settings element, which spans the whole window, and the host answers the call with null; the modal document reports the place of its element core.settings-modal.set, and the page closes the modal by its element id, which the host answers with null.
reason: overlayShow opens a native modal view in the window, and the modal document sends its state through the overlay-pick notice; only the native host with a window produces them (the native tier of docs/operations/examples.md#test-kinds).
